description: This Java source file defines the BookService class, providing business logic for managing Book entities within the project. It includes methods for CRUD operations, updating book details, and integrating with related entities like authors and publishers.

classes.name: BookService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD operations and business logic for Book entities, handling relations with authors, publishers, and predefined shelves, including JSON serialization of book collections.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Book by its ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new Book entity, associating it with authors and publishers if applicable.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Book and removes the author if they have no other books.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all books and authors from the repository.

methods.name: getJsonRepresentationForBooksAsString
methods.description: Returns a JSON string representing all books.

methods.name: findByShelfAndTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Placeholder for finding books by shelf, title, or author (not implemented).

methods.name: findByTitleOrAuthor
methods.description: Placeholder for finding books by title or author (not implemented).

methods.name: findAllBooksByPredefinedShelfName
methods.description: Finds all books associated with a specific predefined shelf name.

methods.name: updateBook
methods.description: Updates properties of an existing Book using data from a BookPatchDto.

methods.name: updateBookMetadata
methods.description: Updates the metadata fields of a Book.

methods.name: updateAuthor
methods.description: Updates the author of a Book.

methods.name: updateGenres
methods.description: Updates the genres of a Book.

methods.name: updatePredefinedShelf
methods.description: Updates the predefined shelf of a Book.
